text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Document No: WTC-001-r0
Issued to: Ataka PS
Status: APPROVED
Procedure:
 Equipment Inspection 
 (I1- M6)
Approved Date: 26 Dec 2006
Date to be Reviewed: Dec 2011
Introduction
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Water Treatment is used in several purposes like drinking, industrial used and 
 services
Water Treatment at Ataka Power Station consists of:
1)
 Demineralization system
2)
 Raw water treatment
3)
 Make-up water system
4)
 Drinking water
We focus on Demineralization system which can be used to remove the salt content 
 of the water after the KSU-reactor nearly completely so that it can be used as 
 make up water for the boiler.
The Principal Parts of the Demineralization Plant are :
1.
 Activated charcoal filters (1x drinking water)
2.
 Caction exchangers
3.
 CO2-sprinklers
4.
 Double stage anion exchangers
5.
 Mixing-bed exchangers
6.
 Regenerative station
7.
 Neutralization plant
For Testing Water Treatment Plant 
 perform the following:
1. Check control valves on pipes and filters tank levels.
2. Check tank levels
3. Check instruments & measuring devices (ph, conductivity) .
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mohamed Gomaa, tested by eng Waled Nasr, revised by EDEPC quality control 
 eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam, accepted by eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed: general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by eng. Mervat Ez-Elden: EDEPC head sector of inspection & 
 quality control's sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified
 and carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The system must be off
Tools 
and Equipment
Digital multi-meter, Fluke 187
Screw driver kit, manual tools .
Oil spray cleaner & Teflon roll.
Pneumatic Calibrator.
External 24 Vdc power supply.
Current injector.
Work to 
be Carried Out
Preparation
Obtain a copy of individual devices (Flow transmitter, pneumatic valve, PH 
 Transmitter, Conductivity Transmitter, Local Gauge) maintenance 
 manuals
Obtain a copy of wiring diagram of system.
Procedures
Check the flow transmitters of the main raw water lines.
Check the PH transmitter
Check the conductivity transmitters of each line.
Check pneumatic solenoid valves.
Check local gauges.
